args: set -euo pipefail; curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"check","version":"0"}}}' | jq -e '.result.serverInfo.name == "model-tier-drop" and .result.protocolVersion == "2025-06-18"'

set -euo pipefail; curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list"}' | jq -e '(.result | has("ttlMs") and has("cacheScope")) and (.result.tools | length == 11)'

set -euo pipefail; reg=$(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8787/registry/example.json); h=$(printf classify-check | shasum -a 256 | cut -c1-64); task=$(jq -n --arg h "$h" '{task_id:"check-classify",family:"check-family",shape:"classify",input_sha256:$h,rights:{process:true,train:false,send_remote:true,export:false},floors:[{metric:"quality",min:0.8},{metric:"accuracy",min:0.8},{metric:"completeness",min:0.8}],qos:{availability_min:0.9,p95_latency_max_ms:60000,error_rate_max:0.1},review:"strict",metadata:{},created_at:"2026-10-19T00:00:00Z"}'); jq -n --argjson r "$reg" --argjson t "$task" '{jsonrpc:"2.0",id:3,method:"tools/call",params:{name:"plan_next",arguments:{task:$t,registry:$r}}}' | curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d @- | jq -e '.result.structuredContent.tier == "system_one" and (.result.structuredContent.candidates | length > 0)'
set -euo pipefail; a=$(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8787/skill/SKILL.md | shasum -a 256 | cut -c1-64); b=$(shasum -a 256 skill/SKILL.md | cut -c1-64); test "$a" = "$b"

set -euo pipefail; c=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp -H 'Origin: https://evil.example' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":4,"method":"ping"}'); test "$c" = 403

set -euo pipefail; t=$(mktemp); head -c 307200 /dev/zero | tr '\0' 'a' > "$t"; c=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' --data-binary @"$t"); test "$c" = 413

evidence_required: Output of the clippy, worker-build and fmt checks.
The curl transcript for initialize, tools/list, tools/call plan_next, the SKILL.md hash, Origin 403 and 413.
objective: Implement the stateless workers-rs MCP Worker serving the eleven engine tools and the embedded skill with request hygiene, verified under wrangler dev.

outputs.purpose: JSON-RPC parsing and MCP method switch.
The eleven tools with closed input schemas.
Compile-time embedded skill, references and registry example.
Build, dev, deploy, rollback and curl transcript.

risk_controls: No secrets, no bindings, no storage.
Checks S-05.C4 to S-05.C9 run against wrangler dev --port 8787 started in the background from crates/worker.
Rust by default; strict TypeScript only in adapters/dsh; no Python and no authored .js, .mjs or .cjs files.
No secret, phone number, account identifier or internal hostname in any file; run gitleaks protect --staged --redact before each commit.
Never write the owner's private organisation name (search pattern O[K]OA) or the forbidden owner-framing phrase (search pattern needs[ ]you) into any file; plain, specific prose.
Work only in the slice's worktree and branch; never touch main.
rollback: wrangler rollback after deploy; revert the branch before.
steps: crates/worker/Cargo.toml: own [workspace] table (detached), worker = "0.8", tier-drop-core = { path = "../core" }, serde_json; crate-type = ["cdylib"].

wrangler.jsonc: name: "model-tier-drop-mcp", main: "build/worker/shim.mjs", compatibility_date: "2026-10-16", build.command: "cargo install -q worker-build --locked && worker-build --release", workers_dev: false, preview_urls: false, routes: [{ pattern: "model-tier-drop-mcp.bradheitmann.ai", custom_domain: true }], observability: { enabled: true }. No account id in the file (wrangler takes it from the login).

src/lib.rs: #[event(fetch)] handler; src/mcp.rs: JSON-RPC parsing and the method switch mirroring the reference (initialize, server/discover, ping, tools/list with ttlMs: 3600000, cacheScope: "public", tools/call, notifications → 202, batches → -32600, unknown → -32601, _meta stateless version check); src/tools.rs: the eleven tools with inputSchema (additionalProperties: false), dispatching to tier_drop_core; src/assets.rs: include_str! of ../../skill/SKILL.md, every ../../skill/references/*.md, ../../registry/registry.example.json; GET routes; security headers; body cap 262144; Origin check; Accept and Content-Type checks.
README.md in the crate: build, wrangler dev, deploy, rollback (wrangler rollback), the curl transcript.

Local verification: worker-build --release; wrangler dev --port 8787 in the background; curl initialize, tools/list, tools/call plan_next (registry example + a classify task), GET /skill/SKILL.md sha256 equality; Origin 403; 413 on a 300 KiB body.
